content:
We had a first look at the Radxa Linkr IP KVM in the first part of the review, checking out the specifications, the hardware design, and overall features at the end of August. That was at the end of August, and I didn’t have time to test it before I went on a two-month road trip. Since I’m now back, I’ve taken the time to test it using an AAEON UP Xtreme i11 Edge mini PC running Ubuntu 26.04 as the target device, so I’ll report my experience in this post. Connecting Radxa Linkr to the target The Radxa Linkr works over USB, Ethernet, or WiFi. I decided to use the provided USB-C to Ethernet cable to connect it to an Ethernet switch, a USB-C to USB-A cable for power using one of the USB 3.0 ports of the UP Xtreme i11 Edge, and plugged the device directly into the [...]
